summary: Iteration 5 tests two features: (a) Landing 6-box grid REARRANGEMENT (Box1 WHITE MANIFEST, Box2 RED middle, Box3 WHITE ink-pen photo, Box4 BLACK pricing, Box5 WHITE tools, Box6 BLACK register) and (b) Stripe /api/billing/checkout with IDN domain bragarmål.no. Backend: 11 passed / 1 skipped (12 tests, test_billing_idn.py). Frontend: all 6 boxes match spec (colors, borders, navigations, image load). Backend correctly punycode-encodes IDN before calling Stripe; verified Stripe session's success_url/cancel_url contain ASCII punycode (no non-ASCII chars). One important documentation issue: the review request AND a code comment in server.py:1745 state the punycode is 'xn--bragarml-b1a.no' — that's WRONG. Actual punycode of 'bragarmål.no' is 'xn--bragarml-g0a.no' (verified via Python idna lib and Stripe API roundtrip). 'xn--bragarml-b1a.no' decodes to 'béragarml.no', a different domain — this needs correction in any DNS/SSL/CNAME docs.

minor.issue: Code comment at /app/backend/server.py:1745 says 'bragarmål.no → xn--bragarml-b1a.no' — incorrect punycode. Actual: xn--bragarml-g0a.no. Runtime encoding is correct (uses .encode('idna')), only the comment is stale. If any deployment README / DNS instructions mention b1a, they must be updated.

action_items: IMPORTANT: Correct the punycode value everywhere it appears. Real value = xn--bragarml-g0a.no (NOT xn--bragarml-b1a.no). Places to check: server.py:1745 comment, any deployment guides, DNS/SSL CNAME setup docs, and any user-facing text that lists the ASCII fallback domain. bragarmål.no is currently correctly converted at runtime — only the human-facing string 'b1a' is wrong.
(Optional) Add a canonical redirect / DNS strategy for xn--bragarml-g0a.no so users typing the ASCII form still land on the right site. This is a platform concern, not code.
critical_code_review_comments: Stripe IDN handling (server.py:1746-1758) is correct: uses stdlib .encode('idna') to convert hostname to ASCII while preserving scheme/path/query, with a safe fallback to the original URL if encoding fails. Retrieved Stripe sessions confirm success_url/cancel_url now contain pure ASCII (xn--bragarml-g0a.no).

All 4 Stripe products (bragr_monthly_nok=14900, bragr_yearly_nok=129000, bragr_monthly_founder=9900, bragr_yearly_founder=89000) are live in NOK with recurring intervals — lookup_keys rename from echo_* to bragr_* is verified.

Landing.jsx 6-box grid is correct: 3 cols × 2 rows, aspect-square tiles, WHITE tiles (Box 1,3,5) all have '1px solid #e5e5e5' border, BLACK/RED tiles have no border. All data-testids are present and unique.
Box 3 image loads successfully (/ink-pen.jpg, 768×1152, natural dimensions confirmed) — no broken image, no cross-origin errors.

Founder pricing route (bragr_monthly_founder / bragr_yearly_founder) correctly enforces rank ≤ FOUNDER_SLOTS (100). Not driven end-to-end because current DB already has >100 users AND our fresh test user could not push into the founder-eligible range — the endpoint's 403 path is code-reviewed but not runtime-verified via /checkout call (skipped test).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_billing_idn.py (new, 220 lines — 12 tests covering catalog, IDN checkout, punycode ASCII assertion, founder eligibility, error paths, billing status)

success_rate.backend: 100% (11 passed / 1 skipped — skip requires >100 prior users which was not the case in this env)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 boxes match spec, 5/5 navigations work — Box 5 → /dashboard redirects to / when not authed, which is correct auth-gate behavior)

test_credentials: Fresh billing test user seeded directly via MongoDB (billing.test.<ts>@example.com), cleaned up in fixture teardown. Stripe key = test mode (STRIPE_MODE=test).
seed_data_creation: One test user + session via MongoDB direct insert (fixture scope=module, auto-cleanup). Stripe test-mode checkout sessions were created (harmless — they expire unused).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Stripe/IDN is production-ready: bragarmål.no is correctly encoded to xn--bragarml-g0a.no before hitting Stripe. All 4 lookup_keys resolve to correct NOK amounts. Frontend 6-box grid rearrangement is verified — WHITE(border) at positions 1/3/5, BLACK at 4/6, RED at 2. Only remaining item is the documentation typo 'b1a' vs 'g0a' — pure comment/docs fix.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Documentation-only bug: server.py:1745 comment claims IDN encodes to 'xn--bragarml-b1a.no' but Python .encode('idna') and the standard idna library both produce 'xn--bragarml-g0a.no' (verified: b'xn--bragarml-g0a.no'.decode('idna') = 'bragarmål.no', b'xn--bragarml-b1a.no'.decode('idna') = 'béragarml.no'). Runtime is correct; comment/docs are wrong. Reproduce: `python3 -c "print('bragarmål.no'.encode('idna'))"` → b'xn--bragarml-g0a.no'. Fix: update comment on server.py:1745 and any external DNS/SSL setup docs to use xn--bragarml-g0a.no.
